name: East Hampshire District Local Plan: Housing and Employment Allocations

housing-numbers.notes: Figures are updated from the Joint Core Strategy (2014), and are for the area outside South Downs National Park only. Total includes Whitehill & Bordon strategic allocation (2725 homes). Housing land supply table shows breakdown: completions 1353, large site permissions 1088, small site permissions 310 (discounted), windfalls 798 (discounted), baseline/reserve sites 275, total commitments 3824, strategic allocation 2725, new allocated sites 2597 = total 9146.
